title: Who is picking up the child?
description: A family calendar with members, responsible people and confirmation of changes. An event shows not only the time but also the agreements.

blocks.text: Everyone sees the time of the practice, but each of them assumes the other will pick the child up. A shared record of an event is not yet the same as an agreement about help.

quote.text: This app has been the absolute best at getting my family organized. We used to be all over the place and miss appointments, my husband would sometimes forget which job site he was at, and my kids had no idea what a chore schedule was lol. I’ve finally started

blocks.text: Separate a participant in an event from the person responsible for the action. When something is moved, keep the previous agreement until a new one is confirmed. Show separately the events where the help has not yet been assigned.

Take one real family activity and change the time. Every adult should understand what changed and whether anything is required of them. If an ordinary shared calendar settles that easily, a separate product is not needed yet.
